address.docs:
**int**: The I²C address of the driver. Defaults to `0x21`.

*See also: [PCF8574 I/O Expander](https://esphome.io/components/pcf8574#configuration-variables)*

id.docs:
**[ID](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#id)**: The id to use for this PCF8574 component.

*See also: [PCF8574 I/O Expander](https://esphome.io/components/pcf8574#configuration-variables)*

interrupt_pin.docs:
**[Pin Schema](https://esphome.io/guides/configuration-types#pin-schema)**: The pin connected to the INT output of the PCF8574/PCF8575. When configured, the component becomes interrupt-driven instead of polling — it only reads the chip when a pin actually changes state, significantly reducing I²C bus traffic and CPU usage. The INT pin is active-low and open-drain, so an external or internal pull-up resistor is required. Must be an internal GPIO pin (not another expander pin).

*See also: [PCF8574 I/O Expander](https://esphome.io/components/pcf8574#configuration-variables)*

pcf8575.docs:
**boolean**: Whether this is a 16-pin PCF8575. Defaults to `false`.

*See also: [PCF8574 I/O Expander](https://esphome.io/components/pcf8574#configuration-variables)*
